intent: Individually authored yesterday/tonight, weekend/holiday, birthday/date/calendar/clock tasks; original changed-plan reading. No audio or mastery credit.
picturePurpose: Original birthday table versus ordinary picnic supports a real scene-selection task. Exact dates, calendar changes, age and clock correction come only from authored text/code; candle count proves no age.

workshop.title: 读清改期便条，校正快慢钟
workshop.instruction: 先找到是哪一天，再辨搭配、选场景。改期只改对应活动，最后把慢钟换成实际时间。

items.label: yesterday：先找便条写于哪一天
items.prompt: 便条：Today is Friday, 23 October. We visited the river yesterday. When was the visit?

wordDecision.prompt: 便条：Today is Friday, 23 October. We visited the river yesterday. When was the visit?

items.material: Yesterday, the river was much clearer.
items.reason: yesterday指说话或写作当天的前一天；这条便条写于周五23日，所以是周四22日。过去已发生的参观可说We visited，不把today的日期直接照抄。

options.text: On Friday, 23 October.
options.reason: 这是便条里的today，不是yesterday。

options.text: On Thursday, 22 October.
options.reason: 周五23日的前一天是周四22日。

options.text: On Saturday, 24 October.
options.reason: 这是明天，方向推反了。

items.label: tonight：今晚直接用，不加this
items.prompt: 便条想说“今晚查天气预报”。哪句自然？

wordDecision.prompt: 便条想说“今晚查天气预报”。哪句自然？

items.material: The sky should be clear tonight.
items.reason: tonight表示今晚，可谈今晚将做的事，也可按语境谈今晚已发生的事；不要只凭tonight就断定时态。this evening也自然，但不能拼成this tonight。
items.hint: tonight = 今晚；this evening可以，this tonight不可以。

options.text: Check the weather forecast this tonight.
options.reason: tonight前不能再机械加this。

options.text: Check the weather forecast tonight.
options.reason: tonight本身已表示今晚，直接作时间状语。

options.text: Check the weather forecast every night.
options.reason: every night说每晚，改变了只说今晚的安排。

items.label: weekend：一次周末，不是每天
items.prompt: 安排：We are planning a picnic for the weekend. 哪个理解没有增加原文没说的频率？

wordDecision.prompt: 安排：We are planning a picnic for the weekend. 哪个理解没有增加原文没说的频率？

items.material: We are planning a picnic for the weekend.
items.before: We are planning a picnic for the
items.reason: the weekend可说某个周末；every weekend才表示每个周末。英式常说at the weekend，美式常说on the weekend；本句for the weekend说明安排在周末，两种写法都不能凭空加上every。
items.hint: for the weekend安排在周末；every weekend每个周末。

options.text: A picnic is planned for every day.
options.reason: 把周末改成每天，扩大了频率。

options.text: A picnic is planned for the coming weekend.
options.reason: 这说为即将到来的周末安排野餐，没有说每周都去。

options.text: A picnic is planned for every weekend.
options.reason: 原文没说every，不能增加每个周末都去。

items.label: holiday：度假是状态，不是年份信息
items.prompt: 记录：Mia is on holiday with her family. 哪个理解有文字依据？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：Mia is on holiday with her family. 哪个理解有文字依据？

items.material: Did you learn anything new during the holiday?
items.before: Did you learn anything new during the
items.reason: on holiday表示在度假；during the holiday说假期期间。holiday还可表示节日，具体看语境。图片里的野餐也可能发生在普通的一天，不能只凭野餐判断在度假。
items.hint: on holiday：在度假；during the holiday：假期期间。

options.text: It is Mia’s birthday today.
options.reason: 度假不等于今天生日，记录没有生日日期。

options.text: Mia is spending a holiday with her family.
options.reason: on holiday说明在度假，with her family说明与家人一起。

options.text: Mia has no lessons for the whole year.
options.reason: 度假不能推成全年不上课。

items.label: birthday：根据便条选择生日场景
items.prompt: 便条：For Lin’s birthday, we put a cake and a wrapped gift on the table. 点符合便条的场景。

wordDecision.prompt: 便条：For Lin’s birthday, we put a cake and a wrapped gift on the table. 点符合便条的场景。

art.alt: 原创两幅场景。左边室内桌上有生日蛋糕、包装礼物和气球；右边树旁有野餐垫、篮子、水果和三明治，没有生日布置。没有文字或日期。不能从蜡烛数量推年龄，也不能凭野餐判断假期。

evidence.caption: 左图已选。核对便条里的蛋糕和包装礼物；图片不提供日期或年龄。
右图已选。核对便条里的蛋糕和包装礼物；图片不提供日期或年龄。

items.material: I am making a photo frame for her birthday.
items.before: I am making a photo frame for her
items.reason: for her birthday可说明为她生日准备礼物；on her birthday说在她生日当天。图片支持识别便条里的生日布置，不提供具体日期，也不能用蜡烛数量推断年龄。
items.hint: for her birthday：为她生日准备；on her birthday：在她生日当天。

options.text: The indoor table with a birthday cake and a wrapped gift.
options.reason: 左图的蛋糕、礼物和庆祝布置与便条相符。

options.text: The outdoor picnic beside the tree.
options.reason: 右图是普通野餐，不符合便条中蛋糕和包装礼物的布置。

items.label: date：问几月几日，还是星期几？
items.prompt: 便条：Today is Friday, 23 October. Which answer gives the date?

wordDecision.prompt: 便条：Today is Friday, 23 October. Which answer gives the date?

items.material: Write the date on the back of the photo.
items.after: on the back of the photo.
items.reason: 问日期可说What’s the date?；问星期几常说What day is it?。便条把Friday和23 October都写出，做题要看问的是哪一个，不能只因为都属于时间就混选。
items.hint: date → 几月几日；day of the week → 星期几。

options.text: 23 October.
options.reason: 这是几月几日，回答日期。

options.text: Friday.
options.reason: 这是星期几，回答day of the week。
这是钟点，不是日期。

items.label: calendar：改期后看新标记
items.prompt: 日历记录：Picnic — Saturday 24 October, crossed out. New plan — Sunday 25 October. Which date is current?

wordDecision.prompt: 日历记录：Picnic — Saturday 24 October, crossed out. New plan — Sunday 25 October. Which date is current?

items.material: Mark the school trip on your calendar.
items.before: Mark the school trip on your
items.reason: calendar用于查日期或标日程；有修改时，以新的有效标记为准。本题只改野餐日期，没有增加一次活动。calendar末尾是-ar，不是-er。
items.hint: 旧24日划掉 → 新25日有效；calendar结尾-ar。

options.text: Saturday, 24 October.
options.reason: 这是被划掉的旧日期，不能继续照用。

options.text: Sunday, 25 October.
options.reason: 新安排明确写着Sunday 25 October；旧的24日已划掉。

options.text: Both 24 and 25 October.
options.reason: 划掉并改期不等于增加第二次野餐。

items.label: clock：慢五分钟，实际时间要往后推
items.prompt: 记录：The kitchen clock is five minutes slow. It shows 14:25. What is the actual time?

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：The kitchen clock is five minutes slow. It shows 14:25. What is the actual time?

clock.title: 慢五分钟：把显示时间校正为实际时间
clock.hint: 试试往前拨或往后拨，再用slow核对：这只钟落后了五分钟。
clock.wrong: 这只钟落后五分钟。显示14:25，实际时间要加五分钟；减五分钟会让差距更大。

items.material: The kitchen clock is five minutes slow.
items.reason: a clock is five minutes slow表示钟落后五分钟；实际时间比显示时间晚五分钟。若钟快五分钟才从显示时间减去五分钟。

options.reason: 钟比实际时间慢五分钟，14:25要加五分钟。
又减五分钟，方向反了；慢钟落后于实际时间。
这是慢钟显示的时间，还没校正。

transfer.stem: Which plan follows the updated note?
transfer.passage:
FAMILY WEEKEND UPDATE
Friday, 23 October 2026
We visited the river yesterday. Lin’s birthday gathering is on Saturday, 24 October, at 15:00. Our picnic was planned for Saturday, but that date is crossed out on the calendar. The new picnic date is Sunday, 25 October, at 14:30. Pack the picnic basket tonight. The kitchen clock is five minutes slow, so when it shows 14:25 on Sunday, it is time for the picnic.

options.text: The birthday gathering and the picnic are both on Saturday, 24 October.
The birthday gathering is on Saturday, 24 October; the picnic is on Sunday, 25 October, when the slow kitchen clock shows 14:25.
The picnic is on Sunday, 25 October, when the slow kitchen clock shows 14:30.
The family visited the river on Saturday, 24 October, the day after the note was written.

answer.display: The birthday gathering is on Saturday, 24 October; the picnic is on Sunday, 25 October, when the slow kitchen clock shows 14:25.

explanation.strategy: 先找便条日期和改期信息，再校正慢钟；生日与野餐分别核对。

steps.text: 生日仍在周六24日15:00；野餐旧日期划掉，改到周日25日14:30。
steps.reason: 只改了野餐，不能把生日也移动，或把被划掉的日期当成有效安排。

steps.text: 慢钟显示14:25时，加五分钟得到实际14:30，正好是野餐时间。
steps.reason: slow表示落后于实际时间；显示14:30时实际已是14:35。

distractors.reason: 仍使用已划掉的野餐旧日期，忽略了Sunday 25 October的新安排。
没有校正慢钟；慢钟显示14:30时实际已是14:35，晚了五分钟。
yesterday要从周五23日往前推到周四22日，不是往后到周六24日。

explanation.pitfall: 旧安排、新安排和不同活动分开核对；慢钟要加，快钟才减。

visual.title: 先改日期，再校正钟点
visual.caption: 日期和钟点看便条；生日图不能推出具体日期或年龄。

explanation.transfer: 如果钟改为快五分钟，野餐仍在实际14:30开始，这只钟应显示几点？为什么不再加五分钟求实际时间？
